project_type: Python FastAPI application with SQLite database for generating schemes of work and lesson plans from syllabus and calendar data
build_system: uv (package manager), pyproject.toml with src layout
test_framework: pytest with httpx TestClient for FastAPI endpoint testing
verification_instructions: 1. Run uv sync to install deps. 2. Run uv run pytest tests/ -v. 3. Start server with uv run uvicorn app.main:app and test endpoints.
setup_instructions: uv sync in project root installs all dependencies
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11 via pyenv. uv available.
contribution_requirements: No formal CONTRIBUTING.md exists. This is greenfield development.
key_patterns: Domain data: Tanzania O-Level Mathematics syllabus with topics > sub_topics > objectives + planned_periods. Calendar with terms > weeks (teaching/holiday/examination + period_budget). Allocation is greedy sequential bin-packing assigning sub-topics to teaching weeks. Scheme of work = table of assignments per week. Lesson plan = per-period document with objectives, activities, assessment.
directory_structure: Greenfield. Will create: app/ (FastAPI application with models, routes, services, database), tests/ (pytest tests), pyproject.toml
